Binomial(100, 1/1000).isf(1e-100): the smallest k with P(X > k) <= 1e-100 is 42 (exact tail sums); scipy forms ppf(1 - q) = ppf(1.0) and answers n = 100.
binom.isf(2.7e-90, 27, 1.03e-13): the smallest k with P(X > k) <= q is 7; scipy answers n = 27 (ppf(1 - q) with 1 - q = 1.0).
